title: Cold Front
start: Talk to Queen of Snow at the Snowball Arena in the Land of Snow's Christmas Village.

rewards.t: Lamp of imperfection yielding 1,500 experience in a skill of choice
Lamp of people pleasing yielding 1,500 experience in a skill of choice
Lamp of procrastination yielding 1,500 experience in a skill of choice
Emotes from previous Christmas events (if not unlocked)
Access to the snowman combat activity in the Christmas Village

steps.sec: Talking to the Queen of Snow
steps.t: Talk to the Queen of Snow at the snowball arena in Christmas Village. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
p: The Queen of Snow creates some snowmen.

steps.sec: Talking to the Queen of Snow
steps.t: Talk to her again. [Chat: Any › Any › Accept]

steps.sec: Talking to the Queen of Snow
steps.t: Continue through the dialogue. [Chat: Any]

steps.sec: Talking to the Queen of Snow
steps.t: Inspect each of the three snowmen and go through all the options for all three. [Chat: 1 Inspect their head. › 2 Inspect their face. › 3 Inspect their equipment. › 4 Inspect their body.]

steps.sec: Talking to the Queen of Snow
steps.t: Talk to the Queen of Snow again.

steps.sec: Talking to the Queen of Snow
steps.t: Inspect each of the three snowmen again.

steps.sec: Talking to the Queen of Snow
steps.t: Talk to the Queen of Snow again and go through all the options. [Chat: 1 Delegate. › 2 Keep it simple. › 3 Delay. › 4 Prioritise. › 5 Be honest.]

steps.sec: Talking to the Queen of Snow
steps.t: Leave Cold Front using the quest marker. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Use the chisel of conditional worth on the coal and make five pieces of 'perfect' coal.
Take 20 carrots from the bucket o' carrots near the hungry reindeer on the south-western wall outside of Diango's Workshop.
Use the chisel of conditional worth on the carrots to make a 'perfect' carrot.
Gather 10 branches by chopping fir trees.
Use the chisel of conditional worth on the branches to make two 'perfect' branches.
Return and talk to the Queen of Snow [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to the Queen of Snow again in the centre of the snowball arena.

Make a snowball with one of the piles of snow and push it to the marked spot at the top of the hill. The snowball needs to be pushed so that it becomes a large snowball precisely when reaching the reticule on the top of the hill, requiring a total of eight pushes. [Chat: Any]

sub.t: You can't push diagonally, nor south from under the Queen of Snow.
At any point, you can break the snowball down, and the pile of snow will reappear in the spot where you broke it down.

steps.t: Repeat with another pile of snow to make an enormous snowball positioned next to the large snowball, requiring a total of 10 pushes.
Repeat with the remaining pile of snow to make an average snowball positioned next to the previous snowballs, requiring a total of five pushes.
Continue through the dialogue. [Chat: 3 She deserves support. Not Judgement. › 1 You taught her to feel ashamed for having needs. › 3 You made her this way. › Any › Any]
Quest complete!
